findings.evidence: The sub-case's comment says 'An input that is not an earlier node is never followed'. At 4b76604 entry fx(1,0) (input 2 >= node 1) and fx(2,0) were both counted and holding_effects[2] was true, so deleting the guard made the case report EffectsNested and the assertion fail: the guard was pinned.
